title: Evaluating Intra-firm LLM Alignment Strategies in Business Contexts
findings: No findings related to religion as the paper does not analyze this topic. The paper focuses on the ethical and strategic implications of aligning AI Assistants with a firm's values, culture, and intra-firm moral norms.
